data.channel: EMAIL ONLY (producer notification; the author-facing release rows carry the link-only SMS, this workflow has no SMS action)

email.body:
Dear {{ custom_values.producer }},

Our editors have finished the chapter, and it is ready for your review at the board.

View the chapter PDF here:
{{ contact.anthology_chapter_pdf_url }}

Edit the chapter in the Google Doc here:
{{ contact.anthology_chapter_doc_url }}

The PDF is yours to view. The Google Doc is the one you edit, and it is the version we use.

You have used {{ contact.anthology_rewrite_count }} of 2 rewrites.

If you would like to approve or request further changes, open the review form here:
https://link.msgsndr.com/widget/form/<form_id>?anthology_id={{ contact.anthology_active_id }}&stage=s5

Warm regards,
The Editors
